summary: Fresh MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass covering /api/months, /api/summary, /api/categories CRUD, /api/transactions CRUD (with month derivation from date), /api/accounts CRUD, /api/allocations list & update. Frontend: All 4 tabs (Dashboard, Transactions, Accounts, Invest) render and function correctly on 375x667 mobile viewport with sage-green + warm-sand theme. Dashboard displays summary numbers ($60,319.45 end / $54,389.89 start / $5,929.56 saved / $233.16 vs $9,208.46 expense / $6,162.72 vs $9,408.47 income). Month picker modal opens with July 2026 & June 2026 options. Segmented Expenses/Income tabs swap category lists. Quick-add FAB opens the transaction editor with all testIDs (tx-amount, tx-category-btn, tx-description, tx-date, tx-save, tx-close, tx-type-expense/income). Transactions tab shows 3 expense rows grouped by day, tapping a row opens editor pre-populated with cat delete/save/close. Accounts tab shows Net worth card ($54,389.89, 20 accounts) grouped by Cash/Registered/Investment/Crypto/Other, add-account-fab opens editor with acc-name, acc-balance, acc-save, acc-group-Cash/Registered/Investment/Crypto/Other. Invest tab renders donut chart (SVG) with 9 alloc rows; tapping row opens percent-edit modal with alloc-input and alloc-save. Category editor accessible via add-category-btn and category-row-*; testIDs cat-name, cat-planned, cat-type-expense/income, cat-save, cat-delete verified. All API integrations working with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.

issues: Default allocation sums to 120% (5+15+30+10+10+10+30+0+10). Matches source workbook and UI shows warning color 'Total allocation: 120%', so acceptable — but consider clamping/rescaling on edit to hit 100% for real budgeting math.

react_native_issues.issue: Console deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking on RN Web but should be modernized.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Modernize shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to clear RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Consider adding validation/warning UX when investment allocation total != 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~400-line file which is fine for this MVP; consider splitting routers per resource if it grows.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} everywhere - good.
seed() is idempotent via count guard - good.
seed_data_creation: Not needed — backend auto-seeds on startup (26 expense + 11 income categories, 9 transactions, 20 accounts, 9 allocations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All base flows validated. Bottom-nav label is 'Invest' (not 'Investments'). Category editor route is /category-editor?month=YYYY-MM&type=... Account editor and transaction editor are separate routes (not modals). Allocation sums to 120% by design per the source workbook.
